The mile, which was considered to be very open, showed a return to form of the holder Bill Nankeville who won in 4:12 from Empire Games Champion Len Eyre and Alan Parker.

The United Kingdom maintained their high standard in these events with 4th, 5th and 11th in the 5,000m final and 5th, 7th and 8th in the 10,000m; great performances by Gordon Pirie, Chris Chataway, Frank Sando, Alan Parker and Fred Norris.
